title: Zesty Canadian Mushroom Hot-Pot
description: A funky and fluffy Canadian dish featuring dashi and wood-fired bake, this hot-pot is a quick-fix and shojin-friendly option for a cold winter night. It combines the flavors of Canada with the warmth of a hot-pot vessel.
instructions: In a large hot-pot vessel, combine the dashi powder and 4 cups of water to make the broth.
Add the kombu sheets to the broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and add the wood-fired baked tofu.
Add the mixed mushrooms to the pot and cook until they are tender.
In a small bowl, whisk together the mirin, soy sauce, and sesame oil to make the sauce.
Pour the sauce into the hot-pot and stir to combine.
Add the chopped scallions to the pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve the hot-pot immediately, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
